beats.en: Some words begin with two letters that we say together, such as gr, cr, dr and pr. Gr words include green, grey, grass, grapes and grandmother. Cr words include crayon, crab, crane, crow and cradle.

textbookBox.concept: Words that tell what someone does are called action words. Examples are laugh, dance, eat, cry, swim, sleep, play, dig, jump, run, write, smile and push.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 3 english · Colours (poem) · Complete Summary
textbookBox.concept: Two small words can join to make one new word. Such a word is called a compound word. Rain and bow make rainbow. News and paper make newspaper. Basket and ball make basketball.

beats.en: Let us review the key takeaway from Colours (poem): Two small words can join to make one new word. Such a word is called a compound word. Rain and bow make rainbow. News and paper make newspaper. Basket and ball make basketball. Earth and worm make earthworm.
